firm_data.firm_description: Jonathan D. Davis, P.C. handles all types of commercial litigation, although it has built its reputation on cases in the entertainment field. The firm provides its clients with the highest quality legal services at rates that are consistent with the size and nature of the matter.
notable_facts: The firm's lawyers have prosecuted and defended cases in the music, publishing, theater, and motion picture industries.
Jonathan D. Davis has been selected as a Super Lawyer for the New York Metro Area since 2010.

email.subject: AI for Jonathan D. Davis, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Your firm's track record defending and prosecuting cases across music, publishing, theater, and motion pictures since 1993 is exactly why I'm reaching out. Entertainment law disputes demand precision, and that's where most legal tech falls short.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on commercial litigation and IP disputes.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
